description: Create comprehensive Phase 4 documentation covering the report generation pipeline, API usage, template structure, SSE format, testing guide, and deployment notes.
steps: Step 1 - Create docs/PHASE4-README.md with the following sections: (1) Overview - what Phase 4 implements (Report Generator with BAB I-V structure). (2) Architecture - pipeline diagram (User Request -> Planner LLM -> Outline -> Writer LLM per section -> Renderer HTML/PDF). (3) API Endpoints - full list with request/response examples for each endpoint. (4) Report Creation Flow - step-by-step API flow from creating to downloading PDF. (5) Template Structure - explain meta.yaml, layout.html.j2, styles.css and how to add new templates. (6) SSE Progress Format - document all event types (progress, render, done) with data format. (7) Database Schema - reports and report_sections tables. (8) Testing - how to run tests, what is mocked, how to add new tests. (9) Deployment Notes - WeasyPrint system deps (pango, cairo, gdk-pixbuf), font installation, storage/reports directory. (10) Configuration - environment variables if any.
Step 2 - Ensure the documentation references actual file paths and is accurate to the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation accurately reflects the implemented code
File paths and API endpoints in docs match actual implementation
verification: cat docs/PHASE4-README.md to verify content is comprehensive
